name: HORIZON
description: HORIZON is a large-scale benchmark for sequential recommendation and user behavior modeling that enables robust evaluation of long-term temporal generalization, cross-domain transfer, and cold-start generalization. It is built from a cross-domain reformulation of the Amazon Reviews Dataset covering millions of users, items, and interactions.
reputation: A large-scale sequential recommendation benchmark that is positioned as a strong testbed for long-term temporal, cross-domain, and cold-start generalization.
notes: Enables out-of-distribution evaluations and highlights gaps in current models under temporal and unseen-user scenarios.
